title: Refill a centre-pull towel dispenser
instruction: Refill the portable towel dispenser. Leave the cardboard core and one dispensed towel on the table, with the lid shut and the next towel ready to pull.
context: Custodial staff refill enclosed dispensers so people can pull a fresh wipe during surface cleaning without handling the rest of the roll. A loose refill needs its inner sleeve extracted and its flexible leader fed through the dispenser's enclosed circular nozzle before use. Janitors and building cleaners held about 2.4 million U.S. jobs in 2025.
setup: Use the stock dual-YAM station and its 1300 × 1100 mm worktop at 760 mm height. Place the dry blue paper roll (150 mm outer diameter, 183 mm long) on its side with the extraction end facing +y. The center of its non-dispensing end is at station x = −160 mm, y = −400 mm, z = 836 mm. The split cardboard sleeve (60 mm diameter, approximately 177 mm long) starts inside the roll, with its free seam aligned as shown in the setup photograph. The molded polymer portable housing (174 mm body diameter, 195 mm before the cap) rests on its side with the opening facing +y and its base centered at x = 28 mm, y = −593 mm, z = 849 mm. Its hinged cap starts open to 158 degrees. The circular nozzle tapers from a 42 mm inlet to a 30 mm throat and outlet, all diameters. The two visible active sheets are dry 380 × 183 mm paper folded and bunched in the centre. All other fixtures are station equipment. The grippers start open in the stock ready pose.
scoring: Use the fixed camera video and a ruler to check these cumulative milestones. At 0.20, the complete core rests on the table at least 5 mm clear of the refill and its case. At 0.45, the refill also seats in the housing within 4.5 mm laterally, 5 mm in depth and 2.5 degrees of axial alignment. At 0.70, the paper also passes through the complete bore in dispensing direction and the catch holds the lid shut within 2 degrees. At 1.00, exactly one sheet has separated at the perforation after the lid was latched and lies on the table at least 10 mm clear of the housing. Its highest point is at most 40 mm above the tabletop. The next connected sheet passes through the bore with 25–100 mm of material extending from the outer opening to its tip. All credited milestones hold for two seconds with both grippers clear of contact. Score zero before the first milestone, for paper touching the floor, for premature separation or for destructive shortcuts.
reset_notes: Use a fresh intact sleeve and two connected clean sheets. Restore the sleeve and the visible extraction seam to the same orientation. Place a fresh refill beside the empty open housing and restore the station's ready pose. Leave the nozzle empty. Prepare the folded centre leader 13 mm beyond the roll mouth, with its tip 15.5 mm to the −x side of the roll axis. After each trial replace the refill and extracted core assembly or reinitialize the simulated episode.
fidelity: Native MuJoCo contact drives the stock dual-YAM station and full-scale refill and housing. Two articulated strips represent folded tissue and retain a crease after a bend yields. The perforation separates only under sustained native tension. The local core, latch and nozzle dimensions, friction and perforation force are estimated. Real samples were unavailable for calibration.
